name: idea-creator
description: Drive a raw idea to shipped, tested software through a research-gated pipeline — capture ideas in a backlog, run each through parallel research agents (market, usefulness, architecture, compliance, feasibility) to an explicit build/kill gate, scaffold a per-idea git repo, author a phased PRD, build each phase to verified-with-evidence, then marketing and human handover; progress tracked as a resumable diary that loops across ideas until every idea is completed or killed.
